+"""Standalone copy of Click's parameter processing order helper.
+
+This module is importable by file path and does not depend on
+``click.core`` or any other part of the Click package.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import typing as t
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_parameter_order", "vendored_parameter_order_variant"]
+
+
+class Parameter(t.Protocol):
+    """Structural stand-in for :class:`click.core.Parameter`."""
+
+    is_eager: bool
+
+
+def vendored_parameter_order(
+    invocation_order: cabc.Sequence[Parameter],
+    declaration_order: cabc.Sequence[Parameter],
+) -> list[Parameter]:
+    """Returns all declared parameters in the order they should be processed.
+
+    The declared parameters are re-shuffled depending on the order in which
+    they were invoked, as well as the eagerness of each parameters.
+
+    The invocation order takes precedence over the declaration order. I.e. the
+    order in which the user provided them to the CLI is respected.
+
+    This behavior and its effect on callback evaluation is detailed at:
+    https://click.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/advanced/#callback-evaluation-order
+    """
+
+    def sort_key(item: Parameter) -> tuple[bool, float]:
+        try:
+            idx: float = invocation_order.index(item)
+        except ValueError:
+            idx = float("inf")
+
+        return not item.is_eager, idx
+
+    return sorted(declaration_order, key=sort_key)
+
+
+def vendored_parameter_order_variant(
+    invocation_order: cabc.Sequence[Parameter],
+    declaration_order: cabc.Sequence[Parameter],
+) -> list[Parameter]:
+    """Like :func:`vendored_parameter_order`, but returns the processing
+    order reversed.
+    """
+    result = vendored_parameter_order(invocation_order, declaration_order)
+    result.reverse()
+    return result

+import importlib.util
+import pathlib
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import pytest
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    pathlib.Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_wave6_parameter_order.py"
+)
+
+
+def _load_module():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_wave6_parameter_order", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+mod = _load_module()
+
+
+@dataclass(eq=False)
+class Param:
+    name: str
+    is_eager: bool = False
+
+
+def _names(params):
+    return [p.name for p in params]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def params():
+    a = Param("a")
+    b = Param("b")
+    c = Param("c", is_eager=True)
+    d = Param("d")
+    return a, b, c, d
+
+
+def test_exports():
+    assert set(mod.__all__) == {
+        "vendored_parameter_order",
+        "vendored_parameter_order_variant",
+    }
+
+
+def test_import_does_not_load_click(tmp_path):
+    import subprocess
+
+    code = (
+        "import importlib.util, sys\n"
+        f"spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', {str(MODULE_PATH)!r})\n"
+        "m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n"
+        "spec.loader.exec_module(m)\n"
+        "assert not any(n == 'click' or n.startswith('click.') for n in sys.modules)\n"
+    )
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], check=True, cwd=tmp_path)
+
+
+def test_vendored_eager_first_then_invocation_order(params):
+    a, b, c, d = params
+    result = mod.vendored_parameter_order([d, b], [a, b, c, d])
+    assert _names(result) == ["c", "d", "b", "a"]
+
+
+def test_vendored_declaration_order_when_not_invoked(params):
+    a, b, c, d = params
+    result = mod.vendored_parameter_order([], [a, b, c, d])
+    assert _names(result) == ["c", "a", "b", "d"]
+
+
+def test_vendored_empty():
+    assert mod.vendored_parameter_order([], []) == []
+
+
+def test_vendored_returns_new_list(params):
+    declaration = list(params)
+    result = mod.vendored_parameter_order([], declaration)
+    assert result is not declaration
+    assert _names(declaration) == ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
+
+
+def test_vendored_missing_is_eager_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        mod.vendored_parameter_order([], [Param("a"), object()])
+
+
+def test_vendored_invocation_order_without_index_raises(params):
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        mod.vendored_parameter_order(object(), list(params))
+
+
+def test_variant_reverses(params):
+    a, b, c, d = params
+    result = mod.vendored_parameter_order_variant([d, b], [a, b, c, d])
+    assert _names(result) == ["a", "b", "d", "c"]
+    assert result == mod.vendored_parameter_order([d, b], [a, b, c, d])[::-1]
+
+
+def test_variant_empty():
+    assert mod.vendored_parameter_order_variant([], []) == []
+
+
+def test_variant_single(params):
+    a = params[0]
+    assert mod.vendored_parameter_order_variant([a], [a]) == [a]
+
+
+def test_variant_missing_is_eager_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
+        mod.vendored_parameter_order_variant([], [Param("a"), object()])
